title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Settlement Authority of the Claims Desk
content:
Settlements under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` are approved at the desk only within an authority fixed for each tier.

## Clause

The desk may approve a settlement up to the tier's desk authority and no further. A settlement larger than that authority is decided by the claims department rather than by the desk. The tier is the one recorded on the claim's cover.

## Authority by tier

| Tier | Largest settlement the desk may approve (USD per claim) |
|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 5000.00 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 5000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 10000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 15000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 25000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 50000.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical amounts)

- Under `AHL CargoCare Plus`, a settlement of 15000.00 USD lies within the desk's authority, because the authority runs up to and including that figure.
- Under the same tier, a settlement of 15000.01 USD exceeds the authority and is for the claims department to decide.
- Under `AHL Standard Carrier Liability`, a settlement of 4999.99 USD is within the desk's authority.
